cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Make It Official
cards.instruction: Recruit someone by giving them a title, role, or ceremonial duty that makes participation feel binding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Would you be honorary patron of our roof appeal? You'd open it and thank the donors.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can come, but I won't make a speech.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then take the patron's ribbon and lead the applause. I'll do the talking.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I leave after the first donation?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll read the names quickly. Our patron leads the applause for every donor.
